thread:
leah: Spawning a quick thread to try a different approach to PM follow-ups: 'follow-up sprints' rather than one-off tasks. Want quick feedback + owners.

leah: Problem: lots of action items linger with no clear cadence or single owner. Proposal below.

tom: love the name. what's the sprint length?

leah: thinking 2 weeks per follow-up sprint. each sprint groups related postmortem items (by service or theme) and assigns a sprint owner + task owners. Benefits: predictable checkpoints, fewer stray tickets.

iqbal: how do we handle critical hotfixes vs longer engineering tasks?

leah: split lanes inside the sprint: 
```
- Hotfix lane (0-3 days): IC + oncall responsible for mitigation and short-lived rollbacks
- Engineering lane (3-14 days): engineers implement a short-term fix, documented in PR
- Engineering + Product lane (15-60 days): spec + long-term change, rollout plan + QA
```

henry: who runs the sprint ceremonies? a meeting/day?

leah: primarily async. sprint owner posts a kickoff message on day 0 with board view + owners. Quick 20m sync at day 7 only for sprints with >3 open P0/P1 items. ops-bot will ping owners daily with a 1-line template to reduce noise.

carla: can ops-bot do ETA enforcement? we keep losing track when ETAs slip.

ops-bot: Automation suggestion: if remediation_eta < today and status != done -> create #followup-escalations thread, mention remediation_owner + manager. See /automation/playbooks.

iqbal: For tracking, can we add fields to the tracker row? e.g., sprint_id, sprint_owner, lane, remediation_eta, manager, recurrence_flag.

leah: yes. I'll update the tracker schema. Minimal fields so webhook is easy to consume: incident_id, sprint_id, remediation_owner, remediation_eta, status, recurrence_count.

tom: recurrence detection idea: run a weekly 'recurrence radar' that groups incidents by service + normalized title (strip timestamps/ids). if recurrence_count >= 3 -> escalate to monthly review with product + infra. keep initial detection manual for 3 matches to avoid noise.

carla: I volunteer to be sprint owner for the first two sprints to get templates right.

leah: thanks! action items from thread:
- carla: own sprint 1 kickoff and post board view (deadline: day 0)
- iqbal: update tracker schema + publish webhook spec to /infra-playbooks (ETA: 48h)
- tom: add ops-bot rule for ETA misses and daily owner checkins (ETA: 4 days)
- leah: draft follow-up sprint template + async kickoff message examples and put into /incident-playbooks (ETA: 2 days)

henry: I'll add a small KPI to Console: open follow-up items by age bucket so we can watch churn.

leah: perfect. we'll trial 2 sprints and re-evaluate. I'll schedule a 30-min retro after sprint 2. Thanks all. :party_popper:
